title: Calibrated Self-Verification & Metacognitive Model Escalation
hypothesis: An independent evidence-based verifier evaluating answers on non-executable tasks (tasks without compiler/unit tests) lowers the Brier prediction error score by at least 15% relative to raw self-elicited confidence, enabling accurate autonomous escalation from local 7B models to frontier models only when uncertainty is high.
falsification_criteria: Brier score error reduction falls below 15% on non-executable held-out evaluation sets, or fails to deliver net token savings when used as an escalation gate.
